tool_args.rationale: The observations establish a smooth, increasing, concave response over the sampled u_now range, but cannot distinguish saturation from a broader branch-dependent mechanism. The open-branch probe is the lowest-cost targeted measurement to resolve that ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a saturating hydraulic-basin model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations vary only u_now; branch effects and competing monotone-concave laws remain unidentified.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a Haldane or Cobb-Douglas model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both can resemble these data over the observed range, so choosing one risks failing the forecast tolerance.
More points along the same narrow trajectory are less discriminating than probing the open branch.
It is explicitly irrelevant and does not resolve the model ambiguity.
